speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me, do you have a specific medical history of conditions like multiple sclerosis, stroke, or brain tumors that might explain your gait and limb ataxia?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To narrow down the cause of your ataxia, are you experiencing any dizziness, vertigo, or changes in your vision alongside these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

REQUEST IMAGES: Brain MRI with contrast to look for non-enhancing white matter lesions.
REQUEST TEST: JC Virus (JCV) antibody status.
